key_insight: Under a fixed four-GPU budget, fleet composition explained more variation in serving performance and long-context coverage than the routing policies evaluated.
clinical_relevance: Clinical NLP deployments face a trade-off between faster responses from smaller models and greater long-context coverage from larger-model capacity.
method: Held hardware budget and workload trace fixed across 24 serving configurations.
Varied model fleet composition, routing policy, and offered load.
Tested factual verification, biomedical semantic matching, and long-context clinical summarization.
evidence_signal: In this controlled evaluation, capacity-aware routing eased a scarce-large-model bottleneck, reducing mean latency and increasing throughput with a small loss in long-context coverage.
watch_item: Findings are limited to the measured serving regime; long-context coverage should not be interpreted as clinical accuracy or safety.
paper_title: Capacity Planning for Resource-Constrained Clinical LLM Serving
